answer.justification: Every logit-level measurement is exactly the no-change value: top-1 agreement 1.000, sequence agreement 1.000, KL 0.000, TV 0.000, Token-DiFR gap 0.000, and raw-score shift ÷ TV undefined (0 ÷ 0). Quantized, fine-tuned and system-prompted models all show non-zero differences at this level (the smallest KL is 0.039 and the lowest top-1 disagreement is 0.945 or less), so none of them fits. Output and activation levels were not measured, but exact zeros at the logit level are enough to identify the reference itself.
